subject: LEEL
title: Labour Law
description: An introduction to Canadian labour law including collective bargaining, arbitration and industrial relations generally. Emphasis on the Canada Labour Code, the Quebec Labour Code and related statutes.

subject: LEEL
title: Employment Law
description: Survey of the employment contract including hiring practices, dismissals, duties of the employer and the employee including loyalty, non-competition, impact of statutes (Labour Standards Act, Charter of the French Language, etc...) and recourses. The purpose of the course is to deal with non-collective agreement employment contracts, which govern most of the working population.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken LEEL 470

subject: LEEL
title: Transnational Labour Law
description: Study of the emergence of international regulation of labour by tripartite actors within the framework of the International Labour Organization; assessment of the challenge of liberalization and competing understandings of development for labour regulation; Engagement with emerging governance paradigms and alternative understandings of transnational ordering for transnational labour law.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken LAWG 515 when topic was "Transnational Futures of International Labour Law" or LAWG 533 when topic was "International Labour Law".

subject: LEEL
title: Law and Poverty
description: The differential character of the law concerning rich and poor as reflected in case studies in criminal law, consumer law, housing law, welfare law. The "delivery systems" available for legal services to the poor and alternative organizational models for legal services; the role of law schools, government and the professional bar.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken LEEL 482
